The '''''Certainty''''' was an [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] in the service of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==History==
In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], it docked at [[Bannistar Station]] to refuel. Here, it was sabotaged by [[Deena Shan]], who threw a thermal detonator into the fuel line that was connected to its tanks.
